verdict.rationale: Docs confirm machine creation and resource management is possible via Console, API, CLI, and JS SDK (paperspace-docs-1, paperspace-docs-6, paperspace-docs-23, paperspace-docs-24, paperspace-docs-30), suggesting core parity for machine lifecycle tasks. However, there's no evidence that other UI-exposed features (Notebooks, Deployments, Workflows, custom templates, shared drives, auto-shutdown) have full API/CLI equivalents, and a probe for an OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s, undermining easy machine-readable API discovery. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that every UI feature (notebooks, deployments, workflows, shared drives) is also exposed via API/CLI, and a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec.
